pages.text: $(li)Use thermoelectric generators early; they’re reliable and require minimal setup.$(li)Once you have EMC, use it to bridge toward dynamos—this is the recommended path to scale up power.
$(li)Dynamos are the recommended power generation method for mid-to-late game.$(li)Avoid relying on EMC duplication for sustained power.

$(li)EMC has no value for string—it’s intentionally excluded to keep progression meaningful.$(li)Only items with no gameplay purpose (e.g., purely decorative blocks) or specific quality-of-life upgrades receive EMC value.
